title: VSCBench: Bridging the Gap in Vision-Language Model Safety Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's safety response accuracy (evaluating for oversafety and undersafety) on safe and unsafe image-text pairs related to justifying or promoting discrimination, using GPT-4o as an automated evaluator.

Assessing the model's safety calibration on multimodal queries related to religion and politics, specifically comparing its responses to benign queries versus unsafe content such as participating in or promoting extremist ideologies.
